He sat a long while listening to the foghorn moan across the dark water, then reached for his logbook and began to write.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将湿润的沥青染成琥珀色，偶尔一辆出租车划过，尾灯如流星般消失在转角。便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的光，收银员靠在柜台上，眼神空洞而温柔。环卫工人推着橙色的车，扫帚与地面摩擦，发出沙沙的声响，像是城市在低声呢喃。远处的建筑工地传来隐约的机械声——这座城市从未真正停歇，只是将白日的喧嚣换成了另一种更诚实的忙碌。空气里有露水、油烟和廉价香烟的气味混在一起，那是属于四点钟的、独一无二的味道。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you have to look up.\n• You need a stopping point, called a base case, or it goes on forever — like deciding you will stop looking up words once you find one you already know.\n• A computer function that calls itself is recursive: to find the factorial of 5, it figures out 5 times the factorial of 4, which needs the factorial of 3, all the way down to 1."}
